name: Can I re-list my home with the same agent after my listing expires?

mainEntity.name: Can I re-list my home with the same agent after my listing expires?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can typically re-list your home with the same agent after an expiration, provided both parties agree. Before doing so, it's beneficial to have an open discussion with your agent about what didn't work the first time. This might involve re-evaluating the pricing strategy, enhancing property staging, or adjusting marketing efforts. This candid assessment is a critical preparation step to ensure any necessary changes are made to improve your property's marketability and avoid a repeat expiration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can re-list with the same agent, but it's important to discuss and address the reasons for the prior expiration first.
